summary: Attended operator browser: one run-level operator approval replaces per-step prompts; https://ekodi.kr (EKODI Platform) is an allowed origin for every recipe. Operator-only start, single-use profile, recipe allowlist and in-memory secret handling remain.
approvalBasis: Owner instruction 2026-11-11 21:07 KST: '자체 브라우저를 사용하는 동안은 아무런 제약없이 진행하도록 권한 부여해. 추가로 가능한 사이트에 에코디 플랫폼 사이트도 추가하고.'
rollback: Restore perStepOperatorApprovalForStateChanges=true and remove the ekodi.kr origin; or withdraw the policy as in v1.27.9.
